}

//     validation of the currency and locale.

func FormatLedger(currency, locale string, entries []Entry) (string, error) {
	if err := validate(currency, locale); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	// Copy so we never mutate the caller's slice.
	sorted := make([]Entry, len(entries))
	copy(sorted, entries)
	sort.Slice(sorted, func(i, j int) bool {
		if sorted[i].Date != sorted[j].Date {
			return sorted[i].Date < sorted[j].Date
		}
		if sorted[i].Description != sorted[j].Description {
			return sorted[i].Description < sorted[j].Description
		}
		return sorted[i].Change < sorted[j].Change
	})

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString(header(locale))
	for _, e := range sorted {
		line, err := formatEntry(currency, locale, e)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		b.WriteString(line)
	}
	return b.String(), nil
}
